_comment: Example brand config for audit-reporting-stinger's HTML report templates. Shape follows the brand.json pattern documented in references/research/distilled-audit-reporting.md section 7 (source: the mcp-md-html-pdf tool's own docs) - logo, a small fixed color palette, two font stacks, a named style preset per document, and footer toggles. The exact hex values, font choices, and footer copy below are this Stinger's own design judgment, not sourced: prd-020's open question notes the real Legion Code Inc. brand CSS (brand/legion.css, brand/colors_and_type.css from the AC Direct engagement) was never vendored into this repo, so this file is a placeholder starting point, not a copy of an authoritative brand asset. Swap every value here for the real brand tokens when they are supplied.
name: Legion Code Inc.

logo._note: Placeholder path. The mark is embedded small, in the footer only, per the scarcity rule in prd-001's Goals section (brand mark applied subtly, not per-section).

colors._scarcity_rule: primary/accent are used only in the header rule, section anchors, and the footer credit line - never as a background fill or repeated per finding. This is the 'scarce primary-accent use' constraint named in prd-021's Goals section.
colors._severity_colors_are_separate: Severity bands (critical/high/medium/low/informational/pass) use their own semantic palette below, defined separately from the brand palette so brand color never doubles as a status signal and status color never leaks into brand chrome. This is the 'severity-semantic-only color' constraint named in prd-021's Goals section.

fonts.heading: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
fonts._mono_rule: JetBrains Mono is reserved for technical strings only (URLs, header names, file paths, selectors, evidence pointers) per prd-021's Goals section, never for prose.

style_presets._note: Preset names follow the pattern named in the research (distilled-audit-reporting.md section 7): 'executive' (authoritative, accent lines, for board/C-level reading) versus 'technical' (data-dense, monospace accents, for audits/API-doc-style reading). Presets change layout density and typography emphasis only, never the brand colors or fonts themselves.

footer.note: Confidential - prepared for the addressed recipient
footer.credit_line: Audit tool created by Legion Code Inc.
footer._scarcity_rule: Credit line, mark, and website link appear exactly once per document, in the footer only, per prd-021 AC-3 - never repeated per section or per finding.

_override_layering: Highest to lowest priority, per the research's brand-override layering model (distilled-audit-reporting.md section 7): (1) an inline per-run override dict passed to the renderer, (2) a path to a different brand.json for a specific client engagement, (3) an environment-variable default brand path, (4) this file as the built-in fallback. render-report.py implements only level (4) plus a simple in-memory override dict for its demo; levels (2)-(3) are noted here as the intended extension point, not yet built.
